subject: modules/canopy/projection/reconcile_lcs_benchmark_wbtest.mbt
purpose: Pre-extraction baseline for the three reconcile workloads (Phase 2 of docs/plans/2026-08-08-core-reconcile-engine-deepening.md, issue #1196). Recorded BEFORE any engine extraction so Phase 3 can be judged against these numbers. No timing thresholds are asserted — this is BAND 2b evidence, not a gate.

observedAt.canopy: refactor/redesign-scratch @ 60bf984f + counter-collision fix (fresh ids start at 5000; engine untouched)

environment.iterations: 10 per bench; one run per workload (mean ± σ)

workloads.positional fast path: two N-def Modules, positionally identical kinds, equal length — the fast path skips the O(m×n) LCS table
workloads.forced LCS fallback: same lists with one Int-typed child spliced at the middle — rejects the positional shortcut, reaches the quadratic DP
workloads.exact-key: reconcile_with_exact_key with kind_tag as key — fingerprint maps for both trees plus the weighted suffix DP; synthetic all-equal-fingerprint stress (not a JSX-native key shape)

instrumentControl.why: A bench that never reaches its intended code path records meaningless numbers.
instrumentControl.observed: control: fallback workload reaches the LCS DP table — exactly one Inserted event at the spliced index (parent = root id, kind Int, fresh id 5000, counter 5001); the fast-path control pins N+1-wide children at every benched size.
instrumentControl.conclusion: Each workload exercises the path it claims to measure.

findings.note: Linear in sibling count; the fast path avoids the quadratic table.
Quadratic as expected; at 1000 defs the fallback is ~42× the fast path at the same width (9.30 ms vs 219.82 µs). The unified engine must keep the fast-path branch.
Aggregate observation: the workload combines fingerprint preprocessing, DP, and realization — ~5.5× the fallback at 1000 defs. The ratio is not attributed to any single phase.

executedProbes.regressionRule: Phase 3 must keep the positional fast path within the B1 band (order-of-magnitude check on the fast path only, not a threshold gate); fallback and exact-key numbers are recorded for comparison, not enforcement. Re-run with the same command and host before and after extraction.
